_doc: Lucent Light, the LucentForge house style (studio/art/direction.md). One light for the whole world; every shade is grown from one base color per material. Read by Mechanics/art/style.py. Change a value here and every grown asset follows.
_light_from: Direction the light comes FROM, in screen steps (x, y): up-left. Lit rims face it; form shadows fall away from it.
_lightness_step: HLS lightness between neighbouring shades (shadow <- base -> light).
_outline_steps: The outline sits this many lightness steps below the base: the material's own darkest shade, never black.
_hue_shift_degrees: Hue moved per step: shadows toward cool_hue, light toward warm_hue (hue-shifted ramps read as light, not as grey).
_grey_tint_saturation: Unsaturated materials (stone) borrow this much cool/warm tint so their shadows still read as shade.
_form: Form shading, relative to the shape's own size: walk from a pixel toward the light and away from it to the shape's contour; t = distance-to-lit-edge / (sum). t below form_light_until catches the light, t from form_shadow_from on falls into shadow. A newborn and a giant shade alike.
_flat_materials: Materials drawn flat (lit from within): eyes stay their base color.
